description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)], [Instant Cast 1] and [200% ATB 1], grants [Dual Awoken Bard Mode I (Edward)] to the user, grants [IV Resonance +3% Boost] to all FF4 allies

description.name: Dual Awoken Bard Mode I (Edward)
description.text: Bard abilities trigger 1 additional time, cast speed x2.00 for Bard abilities, grants [20% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] and [HP Stock (1000)] to all allies after using Bard abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Bard Mode II (Edward)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Bard Mode II (Edward)
description.text: Bard abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Bard abilities, grants [Instant Cast 1] to all allies after using Bard abilities, grants [Dualcast Prismatic 1] to all other allies after using Bard abilities if 4+ FF4 allies are alive

description.name: Dualcast Prismatic 1
description.text: Fire, Ice, Lightning, Wind, Earth, Water, Holy, Dark or Poison abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: 200% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x2.00

description.name: IV Resonance +3% Boost
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 3% if the character's Realm is IV
